questions.question: Explain the formation of a waterfall. (4 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: A waterfall forms where a river flows over a band of hard rock overlying softer rock (1 mark). The soft rock below erodes faster through hydraulic action and abrasion, creating an overhang of hard rock (1 mark). questions.question: Describe the formation of an ox-bow lake. (4 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: Meanders develop pronounced bends with erosion on the outside and deposition on the inside of each curve (1 mark). questions.question: Compare the landforms found in the upper and lower courses of a river. (6 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: Upper course landforms are created mainly by erosion - interlocking spurs form where the river cannot erode laterally around hard rock projections, and waterfalls form where hard rock overlies soft rock (1 mark).
